previous_art_provenance.cover_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Visual concept: two delicate rose-gold and lavender sound-wave ribbons spiral upward together from a single calm frequency point, forming an open luminous helix above a field of low translucent geometric light pillars at dawn. Small musical particles mark the pulse, with an airy sense of sustained build and release. Contemporary editorial electronic album art, clear elegant silhouette and legible at thumbnail size, optimistic for children and adults. Palette: warm rose, pale gold, lavender, pearly teal and deep plum shadow; leave unobtrusive dark space in the lower third for a local title overlay. Distinct from the blue-sky racing ribbons, stepping-stone aurora, circular rings and indigo-glass sunset covers already made. Absolutely no text, letters, logos, characters, vehicles, weapons, copied game imagery, strobing stripes or red neon city. Square image.
